name: Mecha hangar
desc: the service bay where a war machine is worked on, for briefings, repairs and launches
tags: mecha hangar, towering humanoid machine in a service cradle, steel gantry catwalks, overhead crane, cable bundles and hydraulic hoses, floodlights on the girders, yellow hazard stripes on the floor, tool carts, riveted steel walls
prose: an enormous hangar holding a towering humanoid machine upright in a service cradle, gantry catwalks and an overhead crane ringing it, cable bundles and hydraulic hoses running down to the deck, floodlights on the girders and hazard striping across the floor
note: Scale is the entire job and it collapses without a reference at human height - the catwalks, the service cradle and the tool carts on the floor are what make the machine huge. Asking for 'giant' or 'colossal' does nothing; asking for the gantry does. Without hazard stripes, cabling and hoses it renders as a clean showroom rather than a working bay.
